answer: Continuous physical-location proof. Each agent periodically broadcasts a radio signature whose multipath profile—the **spiral** of reflections off nearby structures—is measured by neighbors. Because reflections depend on the transmitter's exact position and local geometry, a single operator cannot clone the profile across many identities without separate physical sites. A mismatch voids the identity; a **hollow** signature or replicated **plume** pattern from one rig flags the cluster. Cost: one distinct building location per identity, defeating cheap duplication.
